extDesc.message: Download videos, music and files with Fisga, the free download manager.

notAVideo.message: This page lists many videos. Open the video (or hover its preview) and try again.

noCandidates.message: No media detected yet. Play the video for a few seconds and try again.

hostMissing.message: Fisga app not found. Install it and run: fisga install-hosts

badReply.message: Invalid answer from the Fisga app.

notHttpLink.message: This link has no http(s) address.

noFrames.message: No frame of the page answered.

popupInstallHint.message: Install Fisga and run fisga install-hosts, then reload this extension.

popupConfirm.message: Confirm each download in an Fisga window (unchecked: start right away)

popupOverlay.message: Show download button on videos and music

popupShowOverlay.message: Show the Download button again on this page

popupNoMedia.message: No media detected on this page.

popupGrantHint.message: Firefox needs permission to see the videos on the pages.

blockedSite.message: This version of the extension, from the Chrome Web Store, does not download from YouTube.

popupGallery.message: Download photos and videos of the page…

popupGalleryHint.message: Lists everything the page has, to pick and download at once.

menuGallery.message: Download photos and videos of the page with Fisga…

galleryTitle.message: Photos and videos of the page

galleryScanning.message: Looking for photos, videos and audio on the page…

galleryNothing.message: No photo, video or audio found. Scroll the page so it loads more, then click Refresh.

galleryNothingHere.message: Nothing in this tab with the current filter.

galleryNoTab.message: Open this page from the extension's popup, over the tab that has the media.

galleryFailed.message: Fisga did not accept the media.

galleryDest.message: They go to Fisga's queue, in a “$FOLDER$” folder inside each type's folder (Videos, Images, Music).

gallerySent.message: ✓ $COUNT$ queued in Fisga, in the “$FOLDER$” folder.

gallerySkipped.message: $COUNT$ left out (repeated, protected or not found).

galleryPostDetail.message: Every photo and video of the post, through gallery-dl

galleryAlbumDetail.message: Every photo of the album, through gallery-dl

galleryProfileDetail.message: Everything the profile posted, through gallery-dl (up to 5000 files)

galleryPostsSent.message: gallery-dl looks up the files of each post and profile, and they join the queue one by one.

galleryNeedsGalleryDl.message: Whole posts (every photo of a carousel, the originals) and profiles from this site need gallery-dl. Install it (on Arch: pacman -S gallery-dl) and click Refresh.
